verdict.rationale: Digits ships an official hosted MCP server at api.digits.com/mcp that lets Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and other agents query live, auto-booked ledger data read-only, and a probe confirmed it is live and auth-gated. The Connect API exposes on-demand balance sheet, cash flow and P&L statements, and Ask Digits answers natural-language questions on cash flow, budgets and forecasts, so an agent can ground an affordability question in real ledger data. Missing for 10: no documented worked example of an affordability-style ("can we afford X?") query, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of answer quality from real agent sessions.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can ask an agent "can we afford X?" and get an answer grounded in live ledger data pulled through the API
